_how_to_add_a_product: 1. Copy the object below into data/products.json (Codex's exporter normally writes that file from the registry; this is the shape it produces).
2. Fill every field. Keep reason_to_buy to one sentence in our own words. Never type a price, star rating, review count or badge anywhere.
3. Put the card image in assets/ (our own generated scene, 4:5 or 2:3, JPEG under 250 KB). Never an Amazon photo.
4. Set status to DRAFT to keep it out of the live site, LIVE to publish it. last_offer_check must be within 7 days for LIVE.
5. Run: node build.mjs   (this writes p/<product_id>/index.html, updates the sitemap, and the home page picks it up automatically).
6. The Pin for this product links to <base_url>/p/<product_id>/?utm_source=pinterest&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=<product_id>

product.title: Plain product name, our words, under 40 characters
product.category: coffee_bar | home_decor | hot_deals | (any reel id listed in site reels)
product.reason_to_buy: One honest sentence: who it is for and the one thing that makes it right.
product.detail: Two or three sentences for the tap-to-open note: the fit check, the trade-off, what to verify.
product.guide_url: https://buyrightnotes.blogspot.com/... (optional; shows only as a small link inside the note)
product.image_alt: What is literally in the picture, one sentence.
